A photo from a walk on 2026-03-21.  
📷 OM-3 & 75 mm ƒ1.8

photos.alt: A photo of a wide dirt path between the trees in the forest, coming to a clearing in the forest with a signpost standing there. Three people and a dog can be seen, with sun shining brightly over the clearing covered in a green grass. There is a bunch of greenery around: grass, and some leafs, although some of the trees are still a bit leafless.
